title: Ithaca Links
bio: Starting this fall, I will be attending Ithaca College in upstate New York. Once there, I will begin learning about film and the aspects of rising the ranks to eventually become a director. As excited as I am to be starting, I do admit there is a part of me sad to leave the school I've known for four years. I am excited to start this new chapter in my life and discover new passions!
